<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">

			aria-controls="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a"
			id="faq-question-bbvshq1kz2a">

		</span>

	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-bbvshq1kz2a" hidden>

You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">

		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">

<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si"
			id="faq-question-pwa036zj7si">
			Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-pwa036zj7si" hidden>
		Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-kg1p336lff"
			id="faq-question-kg1p336lff">
			Do you offer deferred deep linking?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-kg1p336lff" hidden>
		Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx"
			id="faq-question-msj3nqegjx">
			How can I set up deep links for my app?		</button>
		<span class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__icon">
		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-msj3nqegjx" hidden>
		Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">
	<h5 class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__title">
		<button class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__button reset-button mint-h6" aria-expanded="false"
			aria-controls="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv"
			id="faq-question-cabzso5dahv">

		</span>
	</h5>
	<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item__answer" id="faq-answer-cabzso5dahv" hidden>
		Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS.	</div>
</div>


<div class="appsflyer-block-section-faq-item">

		</span>

Meet users exactly where they are with contextual journeys that drive conversion, reduce drop-off, and build LTV across paid and owned channels. Our ESP integrations ensure that links never break, letting you connect the dots between email to app attribution and analytics metrics. See product Web-to-app Guide website visitors to relevant content in your app. Our Smart Banner and Smart Script technology automatically generates deep links across banners, CTAs, and pop-ups, guiding high-intent users directly to relevant in-app experiences with complete measurement visibility. See product Social-to-app Route users from their social feeds to customized, on-brand landing pages, connecting users to the right content in your app and measuring their engagement whether you're running paid campaigns or driving organic social traffic. See product QR-to-app Bridge physical and digital experiences with powerful QR code deep linking. Convert offline moments into app engagement opportunities, creating seamless connections between real-world touchpoints and personalized in-app content. See product Referral-to-app From influencer marketing to the trust between friends - drive new users to your app through direct referrals, user invites, and content sharing. Build frictionless paths from a user share directly to specific in-app content. See product Text-to-app Engage users with time-sensitive messages and dynamic short links directly to their mobile device. The right message at the right time drives re-engagement, conversion, and LTV - whether you're running paid SMS or owned lifecycle campaigns. See product Deferred deep linking Route users to specific in-app content even after they install your app. Captures link parameters before installation and restores them on first app open, ensuring users reach the intended screen regardless of whether they had your app installed when they clicked. See product Link management Centralized workspace for creating and managing deep links at scale. Includes bulk link generation, branded domains, lifecycle controls, and OneLink API for automated link creation directly from your marketing tools without developer involvement. See product Frequently asked questions about deep linking Can I use deep linking without AppsFlyer's attribution platform? Yes. Deep Linking Suite is available as a standalone product, independent of paid media attribution. It's designed for CRM, lifecycle, and growth teams driving users from owned channels like email, SMS, web, QR, or social directly to specific in-app experiences. You get full deep linking capabilities without needing the complete measurement platform. Does deep linking work for owned media campaigns? Yes. Deep linking works across every channel, paid or owned. Whether running paid social and UA campaigns or engaging existing users through email, SMS, web, or QR, you control where each link sends users. Get consistent routing across platforms and devices, plus performance signals to optimize every campaign. Do you offer deferred deep linking? Yes. Our solution is built on proprietary OneLink technology that understands where to direct a user regardless of whether an app is installed or not. If the app is not installed, deferred deep linking occurs: users are directed to the right app store to download your app, after which they are routed to the desired in-app content. How can I set up deep links for my app? Setting up deep links involves different methods depending on the operating system. It's typically done through Universal Links on iOS, or App Links on Android. Another method is using a custom URI scheme, but this is less secure and popular. Do I need deep linking if I use iOS Universal Links or Android App Links? Yes. Otherwise you'll still have to create links for each platform. Our solution uses both Apple and Android's deep linking mechanisms (iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, respectively), allowing you to create a single link that automatically determines the best way to route your users regardless of channel, platform, or OS. What attribution data can I get from your deep links? Our deep links contain rich attribution data about user journeys including what campaign they came from, who referred them, what content they saw when clicking on the link, and more. This contextual information helps you optimize your campaigns and the user experience from the click to when the app is opened. Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more May 14, 2023 Bulk links with new edit feature AppsFlyer customers can now effortlessly edit a collection of links via the Bulk Links management page, saving a significant amount of time and effort. Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more May 08, 2023 Overview dashboard enhancements The overview dashboard now gives you the freedom to view data in either UTC timezone and USD currency or the app-specific timezone and local currency. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more May 07, 2023 Modeled data for revenue LTV D7 with ad revenue data SSOT customers who monitor their ad revenue can now get a combined report of AppsFlyer and SKAN D7 revenue in the Overview dashboard AppsFlyer uses existing revenue data to model SKAN data, and then merges unique installs from both datasets to create a unified view. Measurement suite Generally Available May 03, 2023 Smart Script 2.5.0: URL parameters availability during internal website navigation In the new Smart Script version 2.5.0 – Incoming URL parameters are stored for the duration of the browsing session and applied to the outgoing parameters of the Smart Script OneLink link, no matter on which page it’s generated (whether it’s the page the user landed on or another page the user was navigated to). Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more May 03, 2023 Shareable views Break down communication barriers and easily exchange real-time insights by sharing your saved views with other team members. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more May 01, 2023 Enhancements to iOS re-engagement measurement with Google’s gbraid View campaign details for gbraid based re-engagement attribution on iOS in your AppsFlyer reports and APIs. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 24, 2023 SKAN 4.0 Decode mode Customers who use the decode mode can now switch to SKAN 4.0 by uploading a CSV file that contains their updated conversion value mapping to SKAN Conversion Studio. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 19, 2023 New bulk links management page A dedicated page offering management capabilities for bulk-created links in one place. Before this feature, generating and managing bulk links took place outside of AppsFlyer HQ. Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 18, 2023 Cross-platform measurement and attribution Expand your marketing activities to different platforms and reach a wider audience with the ability to measure cross-platform campaigns to non-mobile apps such as CTV, console, VR or PC. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 10, 2023 New active integrations page in the Partner Marketplace Manage any existing integrations, search within your active partners, and create new integrations for partners in the Active Integrations page, which is now located within the Partner Marketplace for a more cohesive, richer experience. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 04, 2023 Incrementality experiments alerts Identify and understand any issue that could compromise the integrity and accuracy of your experiment results and remediate with suggested actions to address them and ensure precise experiment results. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Apr 03, 2023 LockWindow for SKAN 4.0 in Conversion Studio Customers who are using the SKAN 4.0 mode in Conversion Studio now have the ability to lock the conversion window based on time or coarse conversion value. Measurement suite Generally Available Apr 03, 2023 New media partners validation period New partners invited to AppsFlyer undergo a validation period where their traffic quality is rigorously evaluated before they become available to all advertisers in the Partner Marketplace. During this period, integration is limited to the referring advertiser only. Measurement suite Generally Available Mar 30, 2023 AppsFlyer’s Privo certification Our solutions for kids/mixed audience apps are certified to enable all apps to be compliant with relevant privacy laws Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Mar 20, 2023 Meta’s view-through re-engagement measurement Advertisers are able to measure view-through re-engagement conversions as well as their click-based re-engagement conversions, with Meta via AppsFlyer! Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Mar 15, 2023 Open DSR API enhancements The Open DSR API was enhanced to support and streamline security requests shared between third-party measurement Data collaboration suite Generally Available Mar 13, 2023 Smart Script generator – new capabilities Smart Script Management allows users to save precious setup time by easily managing versions for different apps or websites. Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more Mar 08, 2023 Launch of ROI360 solution we’re excited to announce the availability of ROI360, AppsFlyer’s solution for complete, accurate and fresh ROI measurement. With ROI360, brands can gain a comprehensive view of their campaign performance while saving time and resources that would otherwise be spent on manual data collection, normalization, and aggregation. Learn more. Measurement suite Generally Available Feb 21, 2023 Cohorts granularity improvement You can now gain deeper insights into how users behave in your app overtime by grouping cohorts into weekly or monthly granularity. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Feb 16, 2023 Cross-platform equal attribution priority A thorough analysis of cross-platform campaigns showed that, in many cases, the cross-platform engagement was the one driving the install. We rolled out the equal attribution priority to enable advertisers to configure the cross-platform impressions so they receive equal attribution priority. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Feb 14, 2023 Overview dashboard enhancements The Overview dashboard has new & exciting updates for you to check out: * In addition to pie, bar and line charts you can now add and remove KPIs from your dashboard.* New widgets will be added to the bottom of the page, so feel free to rearrange your dashboard by moving, resizing and expanding […] Measurement suite Generally Available Feb 09, 2023 Suggested Audiences Getting started with audience segmentation can be difficult. Now you can easily create segments by choosing from a curated list of audiences based on best practices for UA and remarketing, and organized by marketing goal (acquisition, activation, engagement, monetization) and vertical. Data collaboration suite Generally Available Jan 19, 2023 SKAN 4.0 We’re happy to announce that we’ve just updated Conversion Studio with the latest SKAN 4.0 capabilities.To view SKAN 4.0 data in SKAN Overview, step inside Conversion Studio to change your conversion value mapping. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Jan 17, 2023 Ad Revenue from Custom Mediation and Direct Monetization Networks Increase product coverage by collecting impression-level ad revenue data when integrating directly with ad networks which are not mediated, when the mediation solution is homebrewed or when the mediation provider is not officially supported as part of the list of mediations exposed in the AppsFlyer ROI360 AdRevenue Generic SDK connector. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Jan 16, 2023 AppsFlyer Partner Marketplace Discover new media sources and platforms that specialize in your vertical. Learn about their services and performance, contact them, and integrate with them directly from the Partner Marketplace. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Jan 16, 2023 Smart banner performance tab The Smart Banner performance tab provides advertisers the capability to test, compare and optimize the performance of their banner creatives in one interface. Deep linking suite Generally Available Learn more Jan 16, 2023 Single Source of Truth: D7 revenue metric LTV Modeling uses existing AppsFlyer revenue data to model D7 revenue for SKAN, and merges unique installs from both datasets to create a unified view. Measurement suite Generally Available Learn more Jan 11, 2023 Automated incrementality experiments Understand the true incremental impact of your remarketing campaigns, at scale, with the ease of flipping on a switch. We’ve simplified the previous multi-step Incrementality experiment setup process to a single “Measure Incremental Impact” toggle in Audiences that is turned ON by default. demo This is AppsFlyer We believe in a digital future where businesses grow with confidence – respecting privacy, building trust, and creating better, safer digital experiences for everyone. 15K+ brands powered worldwide 100K+ active mobile apps measured 190+ countries reached 20 offices globally Our story Over the past decade, AppsFlyer has helped shape the mobile marketing industry. As the preeminent MMP thanks to our world-leading data and our unmatched accuracy and analytic depth, we became an energy source for digital businesses – powering performance through data and building trust in every decision. But the marketing landscape has changed. Customer journeys span platforms, channels, and devices. Privacy constraints are rising. And AI is transforming how marketers think, act, and execute. To lead in this new era, we’ve evolved. AppsFlyer is a complete Modern Marketing Cloud, giving brands the clarity, intelligence, and infrastructure to connect every signal, understand every customer, and move with confidence across mobile, web, CTV, desktop, and beyond. We help over 15,000 businesses worldwide – from innovative startups to industry-leading giants – to achieve sustainable, data-driven growth. We’re combining trusted attribution with cutting-edge AI, holistic LTV measurement, and privacy-safe data collaboration. From user acquisition to retention, from performance marketing to strategic planning, AppsFlyer is where growth starts, and where it scales. What drives us Our mission: Deliver AI-powered, privacy-first measurement technologies that turn data into growth opportunities. Unwavering trust Privacy and security built into everything we do AI-powered insights Autonomous and data-driven workflows that create endless business opportunities Future-ready innovation Proactive solutions for an evolving digital world Global scale, personal impact Precision and reliability across every market Customer obsession Your growth is our success From Mobile Measurement Pioneer to the Modern Marketing Cloud From Mobile Measurement Pioneer to The Modern Marketing Cloud 2011: The beginning When we started, the app economy was taking shape, and businesses lacked the tools to measure, analyze and optimize their mobile marketing efforts. We set out to solve this challenge by building a platform that transforms complex data into clear, actionable insights. 2012-2020: Building trust at scale We became the go-to mobile attribution platform, helping thousands of businesses navigate the complex world of app marketing with privacy-first measurement that actually worked. 2020-2024: The privacy era Privacy has redefined the rules. As marketing evolved and data became fragmented across devices, platforms, and channels, we evolved too. We expanded our capabilities to include deep linking, fraud protection, and advanced analytics. 2024-Today: The Modern Marketing Cloud AI is reshaping how marketers think and act. Marketing journeys now span endless touchpoints. That's why AppsFlyer has evolved into the Modern Marketing Cloud, the foundation for unified, measurable, autonomous marketing. Today, we empower businesses worldwide - from startups to global giants - to unlock the full value of their data, drive measurable outcomes, and thrive in the future of marketing. Creating meaningful impact We believe growth isn’t just about business, it’s about making a difference. Through our Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives, we support education, promote equality, and champion environmental sustainability to create a positive, lasting impact far beyond our platform. Taking care of people and the planet Empowering education and opportunity Connecting hearts, creating change Feeding the world, one community at a time Growing a greener future Driving innovation with every step Whether you're optimizing marketing performance, improving user engagement, or enhancing lifetime value, we provide the AI-powered technologies that help brands succeed. We're more than a technology provider - we're a trusted growth partner for businesses navigating the complexities of digital marketing. 113% Increase in marketing-driven app traffic 12% Increase in MAU Read the story 17% Increase in marketing ROI 1.2M events measured monthly Read the story 32% revenue uplift 4X ROAS Read the full story "AppsFlyer has given us the tools to make smarter, data-driven marketing decisions that help us grow and serve our customers better." Ly Luu Ly UA Team Leader Read the story 52% growth in click-through rate for user-generated creative ads 80% of ad creatives are now successful Go to case study The people powering AppsFlyer Across 20 offices worldwide, our team combines deep industry expertise with relentless innovation. We don't just provide technology - we're your trusted growth partner, turning data into opportunity and fueling the endless business possibilities ahead. Ready to create endless opportunities? AppsFlyer fuels possibility. We turn data into opportunity - helping businesses grow smarter today, and build for what's next. The future is unified, measurable, autonomous marketing. And it starts with AppsFlyer.
